==Summary==

{{pov|[[Rand al'Thor]]}}

Rand is leaving Arad Doman feeling as though he has failed. He hasn't been able to track down enough council members to have a new king named, and the [[Seanchan]] and [[Trolloc|Trollocs]] would soon be poised to attack the country. [[Milisair Chadmar]] and the other four that the [[Aiel]] had been able to track down have returned to their mansions. [[Bashere]] tells Rand he expects them to flee once Rand is gone. They talk of [[Rodel]], Rand is told he has been seeing large forces of Trollocs gathering in the [[Great Blight|Blight]], always just out of sight, but large enough to overwhelm Rodel and his army. As they are about to leave, [[Iralin]] approaches to tell Rand that all the food - in the stores and the food the [[Atha'an Miere|Sea Folk]] brought has gone bad and is totally inedible. There is nothing Rand can do and he steps through the [[Gateways|gateway]] to Tear.

Tear is full of foreigners. He wonders where [[Nynaeve al'Meara|Nynaeve]] and [[Cadsuane]] are and what they are up to. He tells Bashere that he expects the Seanchan to take Tear and probably [[Illian]] and that when Rodel abandons the Blight, they will need the [[Borderlander|Borderlanders]] to return to their posts. He tells Bashere to take a couple of [[Asha'man]] and find out where they are and goes on to see [[Darlin]] and [[Dobraine]]. He surveys the lords with Darlin, thinking how many of them were opposed to him until recently and that better men have died than some that survived. Darlin tells him the armies he has raised are ready to go to Arad Doman. Rand responds that they will not be going to Arad Doman, but will be going with him to [[Shayol Ghul]].
